description: Read-only spot MARKET quote: live execution price, estimated cost (price x quantity), your available balance for the side, and whether the fill is eligible (with blockReasons). Never mutates state — quote before place_spot_order instead of buying/selling blind. Price age is informational only (a market order fills regardless). coinId is a UCID, NOT a ticker — use resolve_symbol first. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

side.description: Spot side: buy increases the coin balance; sell reduces it.
